terminal.title: Live terminal on {{name}}
terminal.hint: The shell runs on the device until you close it, nobody types for 15 minutes or the time is up. People at the device see a notice while it runs. Start and end go into the audit log, what you type does not.
terminal.unprotected: A live terminal needs a protected device, because only its pinned passkeys and keys can let a shell in.
terminal.noPasskeys: Passkeys do not work in this browser. Open the terminal with hauswart-admin terminal instead.
terminal.confirm: Your passkey confirms a shell as {{user}} on {{device}} for at most {{minutes}} minutes, which must start within 15 minutes.
terminal.running: Connected · ends at {{time}} at the latest

errors.invalid_terminal: The terminal session is not valid ({{value}}).
errors.terminal_unprotected: A live terminal needs a protected device.
errors.terminal_gone: The terminal session has ended or never started.
errors.terminal_approval_too_long: An approved terminal session must start within {{value}}.

exposure.title: The server may be reachable from the internet
exposure.listening: It listens on the public address {{address}}. Hauswart is meant for the local network: put it behind your router or a VPN, or start it with -allow-public if that is intended.
exposure.reached: A request came from the public address {{address}} at {{time}}. Hauswart is meant for the local network: check your router's port forwarding, or start it with -allow-public if that is intended.
